artifact.title: Classify a Phishing Urgency Cue
artifact.description: Classify a Phishing Urgency Cue is an original awareness simulation that asks the learner to interpret bounded evidence and produce a server-verifiable result.
artifact.story: Lighthouse Bank has asked the learner to resolve a security decision using the supplied fictional record. The learner is part of an authorized internal training exercise and must preserve a clear evidence-to-decision chain.
artifact.businessContext: Lighthouse Bank needs a proportionate answer that supports continued operations, protects affected people and systems, and can be reviewed by another practitioner.
learningObjectives: Apply Email Analysis reasoning to a bounded workplace record
Submit concise evidence and verify the defensive outcome server-side
artifact.authorizedTarget: Bundled fictional evidence and the CyberMentor local API only
artifact.scope: Local browser simulation; no public target, external address, or arbitrary command execution
rulesOfEngagement: Use only the evidence displayed inside this activity.
Do not test, scan, contact, or submit identifiers for external systems.
Stop if the task appears to require data outside the supplied scenario.
instructions: Read the story, business context, and supplied record before forming a conclusion.
Record the smallest evidence value that answers the task exactly.
Use progressive hints only when needed; hint dependency is recorded in the attempt.
Submit the evidence to the server, review the debrief after success, then write a reflection.
tasks: An email demands payment within ten minutes and bypasses normal approval. Submit the social-engineering cue.
State one direct observation and one defensive follow-up in your reflection.
expectedDeliverables: Learner reflection separating observation from inference
artifact.evidenceRequirement: Submit the concise value requested by the supplied fictional record.

hints.label: Reminder
hints.text: Return to the exact question and identify the field or decision it requests.

hints.label: Concept
hints.text: Name the pressure tactic in the message.

hints.label: Direction
hints.text: Exclude details that do not directly answer the requested evidence value.

hints.label: Partial solution
hints.text: The answer is a short security term or value.

hints.label: Walkthrough
hints.text: Read the supplied record, apply this reasoning: Name the pressure tactic in the message. Then submit only the requested value.

artifact.solutionAccessPolicy: The full expected value remains server-side. The detailed walkthrough unlocks only through progressive hint use.
artifact.debrief: A defensible result for Classify a Phishing Urgency Cue begins with the supplied observation, applies a bounded Email Analysis concept, and records how the organization should verify or monitor the outcome. pair prevention with visibility, response ownership, recovery criteria, and periodic verification.
reflectionPrompts: Which observation most influenced your answer?
What alternative explanation did you rule out?
How would a defender verify the result in an authorized workplace?
cleanupSteps: Close the server-owned session when finished.
Remove any copied fictional evidence from shared notes.
artifact.defensiveExplanation: pair prevention with visibility, response ownership, recovery criteria, and periodic verification
